rv.q: I highly recommend seeing this Joyful Christmas extravaganza in cozy comfort with all your family and friends.
This Christmas production is a warm, wonderful, old-fashioned family show that brims with both favorite performers and fresh, new faces, and dazzles the audience with colorful spectacle and heart.

This is a beautifully crafted rendition of a beloved work of American musical theater,so skip the crowds and the expensive parking downtown and take the whole family to Skokie: Irving Berlin’s White Christmas is playing Wednesdays through Sundays through New Year’s Day at the North Shore Center for the Performing Arts, 9501.
For those looking for a standard take and want to check seeing White Christmas off their need-to-see classical musical list , Music Theater Works production would be a good fit for you.
Irving Berlin's music never sounded better in the Center Theatre and the whole production looks like a giant snow globe come to life…don't miss it!
I think that the cast was powerful, and that Gerritson was able to fill the stage at the North Shore Center For Performing Arts with great ease.

cn.t: Critics praise this holiday production as a sparkling, magical confection featuring Irving Berlin's iconic score, gorgeous choreography, and talented performers who bring heartwarming seasonal cheer to life.
